text_run.content: Zilliz Cloud offers a managed Milvus vector database as a service. Four SDK options exist to facilitate cluster connections:
Zilliz Cloud consistently upgrades clusters to ensure version compatibility. For details, visit the

page. If connection issues arise due to SDK version discrepancies, heed the provided prompts to revert to a compatible SDK version. We'll notify you post-maintenance, post which you can upgrade your SDK without concerns.

All SDKs below offer both a stable version and a beta version. The stable version is intended for common clusters, while the beta version corresponds to beta clusters. If you have upgraded your clusters to the beta version, ensure that you also upgraded your SDKs to the beta version.
The following table lists the compatible SDK versions of each Milvus version.
